card.name: Spot where a parenthetical example comes next
card.fires_on: The last word of a noun phrase just before an opening parenthesis giving examples, such as 'macrolide antibiotics' before '(e.g.,' or the '(' itself. It is seen in drug-label text.

modes.label: Opening parenthesis before e.g.
modes.description: The '(' that follows a drug class or condition and starts an e.g. or i.e. list.

modes.label: Noun before a bracketed aside
modes.description: A noun where a parenthetical or bracketed note is likely to follow.

card.writes: It boosts an opening parenthesis as the next output, which fits starting an e.g. or reference aside.
card.plain: It marks a spot in a drug label where a bracketed example or clarification is about to appear.
